workflows.name: Morning briefing
workflows.description: Scheduled demo: summarizer agent -> conditional Discord post.

steps.prompt: Today is {{date}}. Draft a 5-line morning briefing template: date, top 3 focus slots, one reminder to check Harness tasks. Keep it generic until wired to real sources.

workflows.name: On-demand review
workflows.description: Triggered from Discord with !review <text>. Runs coder agent, posts result, conditionally pings.

steps.prompt:
Review the following request/code and give findings + minimal suggestion:

{{trigger.text}}

then.message: ⚠️ The review mentions *urgent* — please take a look.
